# uptimekuma_notification_opsgenie (Resource)

OpsGenie notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_opsgenie" "example" {
  name     = "OpsGenie Example"
  api_key  = "your-opsgenie-api-key"
  region   = "us"
  priority = 2
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: api_key_wo is never stored in plan
# or state. Change the matching *_wo_version whenever a secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_opsgenie" "write_only" {
  name   = "OpsGenie with write-only secret"
  region = "us"

  api_key_wo         = "your-opsgenie-api-key"
  api_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `region` (String) OpsGenie region (e.g., 'us', 'eu')

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) OpsGenie API key. Stored in state; use `api_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) OpsGenie API key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `api_key`; requires `api_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `api_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `api_key` until the next apply with `api_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `api_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `api_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `api_key_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `priority` (Number) Alert priority level (1-5)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
